scenes.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: landscape inline picture-book painting for the Japanese graded-reading story “The Clock That Was Five Minutes Fast”
Primary request: show the opening situation after paragraph 0: every morning, Satoshi looks at the large clock outside his station and runs toward the train.
Scene/backdrop: a small rural Japanese station entrance in early morning, with the public analog clock as a clear landmark and a quiet glimpse of the platform beyond.
Subject: Satoshi, a school-age boy with short tousled dark hair, a muted teal jacket over a pale shirt, dark trousers and a simple shoulder bag, glances up at the clock while hurrying along the station approach. Keep him clearly readable and natural at small inline size. Use the story cover only as a guide for his character identity and muted teal, ivory and indigo palette; make the inline details much simpler than the cover.
Style/medium: gentle children’s storybook painting in the approved Kasa Jizō inline treatment: broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal surface texture, a few purposeful folds and shadows, quiet simplified background.
Composition/framing: landscape composition around 12:7, medium-wide view, Satoshi and the clock both visible as focal shapes, two or three broad depth layers.
Lighting/mood: calm clear morning, light energy and routine.
Color palette: warm ivory morning light, muted teal, soft indigo, subdued greens and a small amount of ochre.
Constraints: depict only the opening situation, before Satoshi learns the clock’s secret. The clock face may have simple hands and sparse marks but no readable numbers or writing.
Avoid: other prominent people, visible train departure, readable text, lettering, title, border, frame, watermark, logo, photorealism, glossy 3D, dense texture, dramatic action.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: landscape inline picture-book painting for the Japanese graded-reading story “The Clock That Was Five Minutes Fast”
Primary request: show the scene after paragraph 2: at the station, the friendly attendant explains the old clock’s deliberate time setting by pointing to the small box below it.
Scene/backdrop: the same modest rural Japanese station entrance, with the large public analog clock mounted above a plain small service box at its base; a glimpse of the platform and soft green hills sits behind them.
Subject: Satoshi, a school-age boy with short tousled dark hair, muted teal jacket, pale shirt, dark trousers and a simple shoulder bag, stands with his friend Kenji, another school-age boy in a quiet rust-red sweater and navy trousers. Both listen with curious expressions as the middle-aged station attendant, in a simple indigo work jacket, smiles and points to the closed box below the clock. Keep the three figures distinct but simple. Use the story cover only to guide Satoshi’s identity and muted teal, ivory and indigo palette; keep inline detail much simpler than the cover.
Style/medium: gentle children’s storybook painting in the approved Kasa Jizō inline treatment: broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal surface texture, few purposeful folds and shadows, quiet simplified background.
Composition/framing: landscape composition around 12:7, medium-wide group scene, show the attendant’s pointing gesture and the little box clearly while keeping faces readable, two or three broad depth layers.
Lighting/mood: soft late-morning light, warm and reassuring discovery.
Color palette: warm ivory, muted teal, soft indigo, a little rust and quiet sage green.
Constraints: depict only what the paragraph establishes; box stays closed and ordinary. Clock face may have simple hands and sparse marks but no readable numbers or writing.
Avoid: visible gears or machinery, magic, train movement, extra people, readable text, lettering, title, border, frame, watermark, logo, photorealism, glossy 3D, dense surface texture, theatrical expressions.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: landscape inline picture-book painting for the Japanese graded-reading story “The Clock That Was Five Minutes Fast”
Primary request: show the scene after paragraph 5: while they wait for the next train on a quiet platform, Satoshi sets his own wristwatch five minutes fast, and Kenji laughs gently.
Scene/backdrop: a small rural Japanese station platform in calm afternoon light, with a simple bench, a few broad platform shapes and distant green hills; no train is currently present.
Subject: Satoshi, the school-age boy with short tousled dark hair, muted teal jacket, pale shirt and dark trousers, holds up his wrist and carefully turns the crown of his simple wristwatch. Kenji, his friend with short dark hair and a muted rust-red sweater, stands beside him smiling and laughing softly. Keep the moment warm, modest and unposed. Use the story cover only to guide Satoshi’s identity and muted teal, ivory and indigo palette; keep the inline details much simpler than the cover.
Style/medium: gentle children’s storybook painting in the approved Kasa Jizō inline treatment: broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal surface texture, few purposeful folds and shadows, quiet simplified background.
Composition/framing: landscape composition around 12:7, medium-wide two-person scene, their faces and wristwatch gesture readable at small inline size, two or three broad depth layers.
Lighting/mood: soft afternoon light, friendly understanding and a little humor.
Color palette: warm ivory light, muted teal, soft indigo, restrained rust and quiet sage green.
Constraints: show only Satoshi adjusting his own watch while they wait. Watch face is plain and has no readable numerals or writing. Keep the platform empty.
Avoid: the attendant, visible trains, crowded station, readable text, lettering, title, border, frame, watermark, logo, photorealism, glossy 3D, dense texture, exaggerated laughter or dramatic expressions.
